notice.author: Pres_Haruka
notice.message: Student Council Notice: The autumn umbrella rack cleanup in the main foyer is complete. Please retrieve any missing umbrellas from the council office by Friday!

replies.author: Hiro_Class2B
replies.message: @Pres_Haruka Thank goodness! I left my clear plastic yellow-handled one near the B-Wing door on Tuesday!

replies.author: Yumi_Class2A
replies.message: Is the lost-and-found box near the council room open during second period break?

replies.author: VP_Chiaki
replies.message: @Yumi_Class2A Yes! Chiaki will be staffing the desk every day during lunch break!

notice.author: Pres_Haruka
notice.message: Student Council Survey: We are taking student requests for next month's cafeteria special dessert menu! Drop your suggestions in the suggestion box outside Room 2-A.

replies.author: CatEars_Nekomi
replies.message: NEKOMI VOTES FOR STRAWBERRY CREPES WITH EXTRA WHIPPED CREAM!! 🍓🐾

replies.author: Kenji_Gym
replies.message: Matcha parfait or sweet potato pudding would be incredible after gym class!

replies.author: Bass_Sera
replies.message: Seconding Nekomi's crepe vote! Or maybe melon pan ice cream sandwiches?

replies.author: Pres_Haruka
replies.message: Noted! Crepes and matcha parfaits are officially leading the tally so far!

notice.author: VP_Chiaki
notice.message: Reminder for all Club Captains: Autumn Culture Festival booth applications are due to President Haruka by 4:00 PM this Thursday.

replies.author: Akari_M
replies.message: Class 2-A's homeroom booth application was submitted this morning! We're doing a traditional tea and photo lounge!

replies.author: Sora_Drama
replies.message: Drama Club is turning the auditorium stage into a haunted fairy tale set! Form turning in at lunch!

replies.author: Ren_Track
replies.message: Can track team run the outdoor obstacle challenge again this year?

replies.author: VP_Chiaki
replies.message: @Ren_Track Approved! Main field space is reserved for Track Team from 10 AM to 2 PM!

notice.author: Pres_Haruka
notice.message: Campus Announcement: The courtyard bench repaint project is complete! Thank you to the Art Club for painting the maple leaf trim!

replies.author: Aoi
replies.message: The maple leaves look so pretty! Perfect spot for eating bento under the trees!

replies.author: Mina_StarClub
replies.message: The fresh paint made the courtyard look twice as bright during sunset telescope prep!

morning_prep.author: Ren_Track
morning_prep.message: Morning lap practice done! The brisk autumn breeze hitting the track field feels amazing today!

morning_prep.author: Yumi_Class2A
morning_prep.message: Good morning! Who else is running on three hours of sleep because of the new anime episode last night?

morning_prep.author: Aoi
morning_prep.message: Good morning everyone! Akari and I watered the Class 2-A window planters before homeroom!

morning_prep.author: Hina_Class1A
morning_prep.message: The orange stray cat was taking a morning nap right on top of the shoe lockers again!

morning_prep.author: Hiro_Class2B
morning_prep.message: Walked to school with my headphones on. Early morning Sakuraoka streets feel so cozy.

lunch_break.author: CatEars_Nekomi
lunch_break.message: Nekomi traded half a strawberry crepe for Sera's matcha latte! Class 2-A lunch trades are unmatched today!

lunch_break.author: Yuki_Library
lunch_break.message: Lunch hour library reminder: The window seats facing the courtyard are open for quiet reading!

lunch_break.author: Bass_Sera
lunch_break.message: Neko FM played such a good indie bass track during lunch break! Added it straight to my playlist!

lunch_break.author: Sora_Drama
lunch_break.message: Eating egg salad sandwiches in the drama room while going over script lines!

lunch_break.author: Kenji_Gym
lunch_break.message: Who took the last spicy chicken skewer at the cafeteria line?! I was literally one person behind you in line!

after_school_clubs.author: Mina_StarClub
after_school_clubs.message: Setting up the telescope tripod on the science roof balcony! Sunset skies are looking super clear!

after_school_clubs.author: Akari_M
after_school_clubs.message: Finishing up Class 2-A homeroom board notes before heading down to the courtyard!

after_school_clubs.author: CatEars_Nekomi
after_school_clubs.message: Light Music band rehearsal time!! Nekomi is tuning her guitar amplifier right now! 🎸

after_school_clubs.author: Hiro_Class2B
after_school_clubs.message: Sitting on the newly painted courtyard bench watching club teams practice.

evening_chatter.author: Anon_Sleuth
evening_chatter.message: Evening BBS check-in! Hope everyone finished their homework before Neko FM's 8 PM stream!

evening_chatter.author: NightOwl_Student
evening_chatter.message: Late night study session lounge open. Sipping warm tea while reading chapter 4 math formulas.

evening_chatter.author: Aoi
evening_chatter.message: Goodnight Class 2-A! See everyone at morning homeroom tomorrow!
